observations.statement: For every recorded non-affine Policy-0T trace event, root provenance can be retained while residual clauses are used only as restrictions; no reverse weakening rule is required.

The proposed universal translator has explicit bounds S<=m+r+u+b+o and D<=2N+2, where the charged terms are root clauses, local Resolution events, propagated units, branch nodes and opposite-unit conflicts.
Five hundred deterministic random non-affine UNSAT formulas translated to independently replayable empty-clause proofs without violating the explicit size or depth bounds.

Production Policy0T and TracePolicy matched answers, recursive calls, expanded states, branch edges, terminal calls, maximum depth, Resolution attempts and Resolution additions on five hundred non-affine UNSAT formulas.
A separately implemented serialized-proof checker accepted two hundred additional random emitted certificates and rejected four mutation classes affecting pivot, final clause, axiom and parent index.
For every degree and charge, parity of independent MAJ3 blocks is non-affine because fixing all but one block yields a nonempty non-affine MAJ3 fibre.
The implemented affine detector returned no affine representation for both charges at degrees one through four, including the degree-three constant-degree target used by standard expander families.

For both charges and degrees one through four, the JANUS direct exact local relation CNF and the clause-wise standard MAJ3 lift have identical canonical clause sets of sizes 4,32,256 and 2048 respectively.
Combining a linear base Resolution-width lower bound, proof depth O(n), and the 2026 inequality D>=Omega(w^2/log S) yields log S=Omega(n) and therefore exponential proof size.
Because translated proof size is at most a constant multiple of charged execution work, the exponential proof-size consequence transfers to W=2^{Omega(n)} for the exact non-affine Policy-0T core.
Constant base degree and constant MAJ3 arity make lifted variable count, clause count and encoding length Theta(n), so the lower bound is also exponential in actual input length L.

C022 finds no contradiction to the Policy-0T exponential lower-bound chain but deliberately leaves H135-H137 below PROVED status until external mathematical review of the universal induction and theorem premises.
